simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָכַף (H404) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אָכַף (ʼâkaph) means to urge First listed occurrence: Prov 16 26.

definitions.full: H404. akaph אָכַף verb press, urge (Mishna id. , Aramaic be urgent , compare , Arabic saddle ); — Qal Perfect Prov 16:26 ׳א מִּ֑יהוּ עָלָיו (|| לוֺ עָֽמְלָה עָמֵל נֶפֶשׁ ) i.e. his hunger impels him to work.
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; apparently meaning to curve (as with a burden);
